name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
printing: Revised Monster Manual, 2025 release, 2024 fifth-edition rules
pageNumbering: Print folio 372, AnyFlip sheet 375. D&D Beyond byline p. 372.
appearanceSource: Editorial description of the reused portrait. Size and creature type come from the publisher’s stat block.
habitatSource: Habitat line on the scoped D&D Beyond page.
sourceDistinctions: Multiattack comprises one Bite and one Tail with no stated order. Bite bars Tail targeting only while the target remains grappled by the Bite. Tail imposes prone on a hit against a Huge or smaller creature.
The reused portrait has warmer yellow parchment than the other four. Its snout and tail sit close to the circular crop edge.
The publisher’s errata page and its v1.0 list no correction for this beast.
